limitations.name: Manual canvas marks survive a menu transition at the same URL and viewport
limitations.evidence: Record 013 adds four manual regions. Record 014 returns them on the main game. Record 015 opens the bet selector. Record 016 shows the selector but returns the identical four manual controls, including a spin label at a location now used for confirmation. Record 017 explicitly clears them.
limitations.consequence: Fresh observation metadata does not make caller-provided canvas labels semantically current after an in-canvas state change. Clear and remark when the menu changes.

limitations.status: Historical omission in record 038. Final restarted MCP check 110 selects four frames in the first 1000 ms and reports the correct ws preset and transport.

providers.frameAssociationLimit: Labels persist on subsequent background frames until another action. The 10 associated frames include heartbeat and repeated balance traffic; they are not 10 separate spin operations.

observationLimitations.finding: Inspected observations returned a generic DOM body and the warning OK button when present. They did not return semantic canvas button controls; core game actions required visual coordinates.
Visible text was limited to 1000 characters. The returned rules/paytable text is not a complete extraction.
needsVision=false appeared during loading observations. This flag alone did not establish ready or fully interpreted game controls.
stable=true across three sampled observations establishes the reported observation stability only; it does not prove the canvas animation had stopped.
A successful close click was followed by a transitional screenshot; a later screenshot was required to confirm the dialog had closed.
Only the displayed Buy Feature offer was inspected. The offer was not purchased.

protocol.scope: Selected non-sensitive protocol evidence associated with the single GamesGlobal demo spin. No terminal visual result is inferred.

response.completionQualification: No explicit wager-complete response boolean was identified. Stage 0 reports played=1 and remain=0; stage 1 reports played=0, remain=1 and avail=True. These are captured protocol fields, not a verified terminal screenshot.

separateClientTelemetry.qualification: iswagercomplete=true is in a client telemetry request, not the game-command server response.

interpretationLimits: The request contains raw denomination=2, level=1, wager=20. The response financials state betAmount=0.2; no undocumented monetary-unit mapping is asserted.
Only the observed request action Play / BaseGame / Spin is reported; advertised possible actions were not executed or validated.
No URLs, cookies, tokens, session/player/request/correlation identifiers, XML Id attributes, transaction numbers, or raw payload text are retained.
The captured XML-like strings are not well-formed for a strict XML parser. Selected attributes were read with a tolerant parser and the echoed request fields match exactly.

visualResult.note: Win and restored spin control were observed at 22.1 seconds. A later read-only screenshot after analysis showed the neutral final board; there was no additional requested wait after the outcome screenshot.

limitations: Only YES, I AM and marketing PLAY were semantic DOM controls. All in-game buttons required fresh screenshotId plus image-pixel coordinates.
UMCP reported four parent-page DOM controls while game menus changed: generic body/div wrappers and modal close span, not game controls.
The iframe canvas was opaque with PixiJS detected only by global signature; sceneAccessible=false and canvas text=[] on game screens.
Rules text was extractable from frame 1 but output was limited to 1000 characters; Settings exposed its heading but not canvas toggle labels/state.
Visible text from the underlying marketing page continued to appear while covered by the game modal.
Async checkwin settlement was labeled with the latest wait action rather than the initiating spin; action marks indicate temporal attribution rather than semantic causality.

Activity capture retained about 5.43 MB including game asset fetches; with the intentional 262144-byte body cap it reported 19 truncatedBodies, 2 omittedBodies and 1 bodyError. The minimal exported spin window contained two HTTP entries.

providers.httpEvidence: Public launcher returned 200; game client redirected to a region-unavailable page.

crossCuttingFindings: Delivered input is not proof of the requested UI outcome; settings and autoplay dismissal on NGM required separate outcome checks.
Manual canvas labels can become semantically stale without navigation.
Action marks provide temporal attribution; background traffic and asynchronous settlement need not carry the initiating spin label.
Observation stability and needsVision do not establish stopped canvas animation, complete semantics, readiness, or atomic screenshot/text capture.
Capture losses and externally blocked providers qualify the findings; neither complete capture nor universal game access is claimed.

setupNavigationError.reason: Certificate-authority navigation error before temporary CA trust setup.

callAccounting.definition: MCP isError flags are counted separately from navigation errors. HTTP provider failures and unsuccessful UI outcomes are documented in their provider sections.
